example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথাবার্তায় ঊনপঞ্চাশ বায়ু লেগেছে মনে হচ্ছে।
এই সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ায় তার মাথায় ঊনপঞ্চাশ বায়ু এসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: It seems like forty-nine winds have blown into his speech, making him sound mad.
His decision shows that forty-nine winds of madness have entered his head.
note: This idiom metaphorically suggests a chaotic, whirlwind-like state of mind akin to being buffeted by strong winds, rooted in Bengali folk expressions.
